people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

translations.web: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.
translations.bsb: This is the burden against Damascus: “Behold, Damascus is no longer a city; it has become a heap of ruins.
